description: GCodeProcessor mutations validate normal Marlin minimum feed rates, filament loading delay, and filament cost summaries.

case_names: Machine minimum feed rates set independent estimator floors
Filament changes add configured load, unload, and tool delays
Filament summaries use diameter, density, and price settings

mutants.intended_failed_case: Machine minimum feed rates set independent estimator floors
mutants.description: Give a zero machine_min_travel_rate an unintended 2 mm/s floor instead of preserving the commanded F90 speed. The positive 30 mm/s row remains unaffected; the explicit zero fallback time oracle must fail.

mutants.intended_failed_case: Machine minimum feed rates set independent estimator floors
mutants.description: Ignore the configured positive minimum extrusion rate. The 100 mm row must no longer estimate a move time near 100/24 seconds.

mutants.intended_failed_case: Filament changes add configured load, unload, and tool delays
mutants.description: Drop the configured load-time contribution for both the initial filament selection and the second-slot load; the aggregate load statistic and total estimated delay must fail.

mutants.intended_failed_case: Filament summaries use diameter, density, and price settings
mutants.description: Omit the configured price-per-kilogram factor when converting filament mass to cost. The positive-price summary must stop reporting 0.31 while the zero-price row remains zero.
